description: Prepared native hypoDD relocation input folder.

required_files.hypoDD.inp: Native hypoDD control file using the canonical local filenames
required_files.event.dat: Initial event catalog; required for direct CT/CT+CC mode and generated by ph2dt when --run-ph2dt is used
required_files.dt.ct: Catalog differential times; required unless --run-ph2dt is used

ph2dt_addition: --run-ph2dt additionally requires ph2dt.inp and phase.dat; the adapter stages canonical input/ paths before running ph2dt
read_only: The input directory is copied into the writable output directory and is never modified.

modes.ct: Uses dt.ct and catalog differential times.
modes.ct_cc: Requires dt.ct and dt.cc and uses catalog plus waveform cross-correlation times.
